expected_structural_delta: No new owner, field, or configuration key. One conditional environment argument in the GitHub provider, plus a README sentence and tests.
minimum_design: In named-pool layout, when the effective labels omit self-hosted, pass NO_DEFAULT_LABELS=true to the runner image, which already supports it. Pools that list self-hosted and single-layout runners stay unchanged.
outcome: A runner pool that omits self-hosted registers with only its declared labels, so a generic runs-on: self-hosted job cannot land on a small dedicated lane.

reuse_decisions.name: Runner image NO_DEFAULT_LABELS option
reuse_decisions.rationale: The base image entrypoint already maps it to config.sh --no-default-labels.

reuse_decisions.name: Pool labels field
reuse_decisions.rationale: The README already says pool labels pass to the runner directly, so no new record field or configuration key is needed.
